# Math / LaTeX Sample

In the app, math shows as its LaTeX source. Export to HTML (or Print via
Browser / PDF) to see it typeset by MathJax.

Inline math: the quadratic formula is $x = \frac{-b \pm \sqrt{b^2 - 4ac}}{2a}$.

Display math:

$$
E = mc^2
$$

$$
\int_{-\infty}^{\infty} e^{-x^2}\,dx = \sqrt{\pi}
$$
